final.final_answer:
Findings are based only on GitHub repository pages for astral-sh/uv.

1. Supported operating systems / platforms
- The main README on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv (Code tab, README section) explicitly states: “Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.” This describes the supported operating systems in general terms.

2. Documented standalone installer commands (Linux/macOS and Windows)
From the main README at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv (Code tab, Installation section):
- Linux or macOS standalone installer command:
  - Under the “Installation” heading, the README says “Install uv with our standalone installers:” and then shows the Unix shell command (preceded by a comment “# On macOS and Linux.”):
    - `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
  - This is presented as the standalone installer command for macOS and Linux.

- Windows standalone installer command:
  - In the same “Installation” section, immediately after the Unix command, the README shows the Windows PowerShell command (preceded by “# On Windows.”):
    - `powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c " irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex "`
  - This is the documented installer command for Windows.

3. Package-manager installation alternatives (from the README)
Also in the “Installation” section of the main README at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv:
- The README introduces PyPI as an alternative: “Or, from PyPI :”
- It then lists two package-manager–based installation commands, each labeled in comments:
  - “# With pip.” followed by:
    - `pip install uv`
  - “# Or pipx.” followed by:
    - `pipx install uv`
These are the package-manager installation alternatives explicitly shown in the README.

4. Latest stable release tag and publication date
- On the GitHub release page for version 0.12.5 at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.12.5, the page heading shows “0.12.5” with a “Latest” label, and the release header text states “Released on 2026-08-14.” 
- This establishes that:
  - Latest stable release tag: 0.12.5
  - Publication date: 2026-08-14

5. Repository license
- In the README’s “License” section on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv, the project links two license files in the repository root:
  - `LICENSE-APACHE` (linked from the text “LICENSE-APACHE”), which corresponds to the Apache License, Version 2.0, and is located at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/main/LICENSE-APACHE.
  - `LICENSE-MIT` (linked from the text “LICENSE-MIT”), which corresponds to the MIT License, and is located at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/main/LICENSE-MIT.
- GitHub’s repository sidebar on the same main page also summarizes this as “Apache-2.0, MIT licenses found,” matching the two license files.
- Therefore, the repository is dual-licensed under:
  - Apache License 2.0 (via LICENSE-APACHE)
  - MIT License (via LICENSE-MIT)

Summary of requested items, tied to GitHub sources
- Supported OS/platforms: README on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv states “Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.”
- Standalone installer command for Linux/macOS: From README “Installation” section on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv — `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`.
- Standalone installer command for Windows: From the same README “Installation” section — `powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c " irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex "`.
- Package-manager alternatives: From README “Installation” on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv — `pip install uv` and `pipx install uv` (under “Or, from PyPI :”).
- Latest stable release and date: From release page https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.12.5 — tag 0.12.5, “Released on 2026-08-14.”
- Repository license: From README “License” section on https://github.com/astral-sh/uv and linked files LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT in the repo root — dual-licensed under Apache-2.0 and MIT.
